domain-information: A Student assigns a subject for the next tutoring session to improve their understanding.
A Student submits homework questions so the tutor can prepare for the session.
A Parent books a new tutoring package to support their child’s long-term learning.
A Parent updates the student’s availability to allow proper session scheduling.
A Tutor reviews the student’s submitted questions to plan the lesson.
A Tutor conducts a tutoring session to explain key concepts and provide practice.
A Tutor records the student’s progress after the session to track improvement.
An Academic Coordinator reviews a booking for a tutor package.
An Academic Coordinator assigns a tutor to the student based on subject needs.
An Academic Coordinator reviews progress records to ensure the student is on track.
An Academic Coordinator adjusts the learning plan to better support the student’s goals.
